answer_1.quote: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have enhanced text summarization performance.

answer_2.quote: Automated metrics have also evolved: from traditional similarity-based measures like ROUGE, BERTScore, and BARTScore; to natural language inference (NLI) and question answering (QA)-based methods; and finally to LLM-based approaches.

answer_3.quote: We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs as summarizers for English and Chinese, using our multi-dimensional annotations.

answer_4.quote: We collect our human annotations via Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk), with each annotation unit assigned to three independent annotators to ensure reliability.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate faithfulness at the sentence-level by identifying factual errors based on the existing error taxonomy and verify whether each key-fact can be inferred from the summary sentences, similar to an NLI task.
